prompt:
Mobile web page design comp for the Kleaner services page, the boldest super-app variant: a sticky bottom app-style tab bar of the four groups (Home cleaning, After renovation, Specialist care, Moving) with line icons, fixed at the bottom of the screen like a native app, and the page above it reading like an app's home feed. Shown from the top through the start of the specialist group. Regions in order: (1) slim 64px header, "kleaner" logo left, a round blue WhatsApp chat button right. (2) Hero split inside the phone width: big left-aligned two-line headline in a heavy rounded sans taking the full width, subtext, the "Book now" filled blue pill and "WhatsApp us" outlined pill, then a rounded photo of a cleaner in a navy polo wiping a kitchen counter in a Malaysian condo, cropped tall. (3) "Home cleaning" as a bento of three tiles: one tall photo tile on the left for Standard Cleaning and two stacked tiles on the right for Deep Cleaning and Move In / Move Out Cleaning, names, one line each and "Book now" pills sitting below each photo. (4) "After renovation": one full-width wide photo tile for Post Renovation Cleaning with Formaldehyde Removal as a compact row beneath it. (5) "Specialist care" heading starting. The fixed bottom tab bar with the active group highlighted in blue.

Real content to use, spelled exactly: brand wordmark "kleaner" in lowercase bright blue #0088F8 with tiny tagline beneath. Headline "Your home, our honour." Subtext "Home cleaning, renovation clean-ups, aircond, upholstery and moving across Klang Valley. Pick a service and book." Buttons "Book now" (filled blue #0071D1, white text) and "WhatsApp us". Group pills "Home cleaning", "After renovation", "Specialist care", "Moving". Services: Standard Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, Move In / Move Out Cleaning (home cleaning group); Post Renovation Cleaning, Formaldehyde Removal (after renovation group); Aircond Maintenance, Sofa & Mattress Cleaning, Curtain & Carpet Cleaning (specialist care group); Mover (moving group). Every cleaning service button says "Book now"; Mover says "Get a quote". Photography is realistic: Malaysian condo and terrace homes in Klang Valley, natural daylight, cleaners in plain navy polo uniforms with no logos, no text inside any photo. Icons are thin regular-weight line icons. One accent colour only (Kleaner blue), white and very light cool grey ground, near-black navy text, one soft rounded-corner system, pill buttons. No em dashes, no eyebrow labels above headings, no section numbers, no labels or badges overlaid on photos, no prices, no ratings, no reviews, no stars. Render the web page itself edge to edge at a 390px-wide phone viewport, portrait, no device frame, no browser chrome, no hand.
